```{r}
disease_information <- read.delim("Group_11/Group11/Disease_information.txt")
IMPC_parameter_description <-read.delim2("Group_11/Group11/IMPC_parameter_description.txt" , sep = ",")
IMPC_procedure <-read.delim2("Group_11/Group11/IMPC_procedure.txt" , sep = ",")
IMPC_SOP <-read.csv("Group_11/Group11/IMPC_SOP.csv")
query_genes <-read.csv("Group_11/Group11/query_genes.csv")

```

```{r}
all_reads <- list()
for (path_to_record in list.files("Group_11/Group11/data/", full.names = TRUE) ){
   all_reads[[basename(path_to_record)]] <- read.csv(file = path_to_record, header = FALSE,
  col.names = c("dataField", "value"))
}
```

```{r}
saveRDS(object = all_reads , file = "all_records.rds")
```

```{r}
all_records <- readRDS(file = "all_records.rds")
```






We have 8 variables to check through SOP. 
We have a list with all records - all_records . 
Each variable will be compared consequently with SOP requirements, and the ones that are wrong - deleted from all_records.


```{r}
for (record_basename in names(all_records)){
  analysed_df <- all_records[[record_basename]]
  if (nrow(analysed_df) != 8) {
    all_records[[record_basename]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  for (row_number in seq_along(analysed_df$dataField)){
    SOP_reference_row <- IMPC_SOP[IMPC_SOP$dataField == tolower(trimws(analysed_df$dataField[row_number])),] # In some of the records, the dataField value was from capital, so the tolower() lowers it. trimws() removes the spaces from the sides. 
    min_value <- as.numeric(SOP_reference_row$minValue)
    max_value <- as.numeric(SOP_reference_row$maxValue)
    row_value <- analysed_df[,2][row_number]
    if (SOP_reference_row$dataType == "String"){
      row_value <- as.character(row_value)
      n_characters <- nchar(row_value)
      if (is.na(n_characters)) {
        all_records[[record_basename]] <- NULL
        break
      }
      if (min_value > n_characters | max_value < n_characters) {
        all_records[[record_basename]] <- NULL
        break
      }
    } else if (SOP_reference_row$dataType == "Float"){
      row_value <- as.numeric(row_value)
      if (is.na(row_value)) {
      all_records[[record_basename]] <- NULL
      break
      }
      if (min_value > row_value | max_value < row_value) {
        all_records[[record_basename]] <- NULL
        break
      }
    }
  }

}


```


```{r}
saveRDS(object = all_records , file = "clean_records.rds")
```

```{r}
clean_records <- readRDS(file = "clean_records.rds")
```
